🚨 𝐈𝐍𝐓’𝐋 𝐖𝐀𝐓𝐂𝐇: Barça players in action for their national teams today —

🇪🇬: Hamza Abdelkarim vs. Malawi

🇪🇸: Marc Bernal vs. Albania U21

🇵🇹: João Cancelo vs. Wales

🚨🎙️| Lucas Vázquez: "I think Lamine is something we've NEVER seen before. A player so important at that age, at least I've never seen it. We've had other players in the running for the Ballon d'Or, but he already has the status of a HUGE star." #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Alongside monitoring 20-year-old Cagliari centre-back Juan Rodríguez, Barça scouts also traveled to La Bombonera for the Argentina–Uruguay match to observe him alongside Lisandro Martínez, though no deal is currently in the works. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive
🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: PSG want BALDE. [@CorSport - pending further confirmation] #fcblive 🔵

Raphinha and Carlo Ancelotti, both suspended, watching the Singapore vs. Brazil game from the stands.

Brazil are 4-0 ahead in the 32nd minute. 🇧🇷⚽
🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Jorge Mendes is set to arrive in Barcelona today to hold a face-to-face meeting with Alejandro Balde and assess his future. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Jules Koundé is CLOSE to returning. He has been experiencing positive sensations and is aiming the Villarreal game. Kounde is expected to rejoin group training on Thursday. [@fansjavimiguel & @NilSola10] #fcblive 🇫🇷
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona have reached a verbal agreement to renew Brian Fariñas’ contract until 2031. Hansi Flick is convinced of the player. [@Nilsola10] #fcblive 🔵🔴

🚨 Who's the first to arrive at training?

Gordon: "Christensen, everytime I come he's in the shower (laughs)." #fcblive 😂

🚨 Who would make the better manager?

Gordon: "Frenkie de Jong, because of his football intelligence". #fcblive 🇳🇱
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Jorge Mendes and Alejandro Balde are currently meeting to discuss the defender’s future. Several clubs, particularly from Italy, are interested in him. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive 🇪🇸
Adeyemi is KA CHOWWWWW 🔥

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Deco is still a huge admirer of Alessandro Bastoni, but any move for the defender would require Hansi Flick’s approval. Flick previously preferred a different profile. [@MatteMoretto] #fcblive 🇮🇹
❗| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Liverpool will push to reduce the €55M buy-option fee for Ronald Araújo, hoping to secure a deal with the player’s backing. [@sport] #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Rodri: “The start to the season has been outstanding, but CONSISTENCY matters more. The defeats against PSG and Madrid were a learning experience, showing us that we may need to ADJUST our approach against bigger teams.” [@scapde_45] #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Rodri on Hansi Flick: "He communicates clearly and directly, making it easy to understand his expectations. From day one, he has encouraged me to FOCUS on my performance, help my teammates and guide the younger players. We share a CLOSE relationship built on mutual respect.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Rodri: "Barça’s goal is to compete for EVERY trophy without putting labels on ourselves. We must keep improving and reach March and April at our best to FIGHT for everything.” #fcblive
𝐖𝐈𝐍𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌 in today's training ❤️
🚨 𝐈𝐍𝐓’𝐋 𝐖𝐀𝐓𝐂𝐇: João Cancelo STARTS for Portugal against Wales. 🇵🇹

🚨🎙️| Rodri on Barça’s Champions League chances: “There’s not much point in putting labels on things or debating whether we’re favourites. It’s been a long time since Barça won the Champions League, and it’s the title we want most. We have to stay humble and understand there’s still a lot of room for improvement. We shouldn’t see ourselves as favourites, but work to raise our level”. #fcblive 🔵🔴
🚨🎙️| Jürgen Klopp: “I've always been an admirer of Ter Stegen. I wanted him to sign for Liverpool, but he chose Barcelona.” 🇩🇪
On your toes. Get. Set. GO 🏃💨
🚨🎙️| Luis Suárez: "Neymar leaving? Messi and I did everything to CONVINCE Neymar to stay in 2017. Messi even told him he could help him win the Ballon d’Or.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Luis Suárez: “I hope this is the year Barça finally lift the UCL again, but the real question is how the team will reach the decisive stages of the season. That happened to us in 2019. We were just 2-3 games away from winning the treble, but in the end, we only managed to win La Liga. Within a few days, we went from having the chance to win everything to missing out on two major trophies. That’s the cruel side of football, and that’s the level of expectation at Barcelona.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Luis Suárez: "MSN? There was no selfishness between us. We helped each other, shared goals and penalties. They helped me to win in the golden boot. We enjoyed years of great friendship.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Luis Suárez: "Leaving Barça? It HURTS to leave in 2020, but with time, I realised it may have been the best decision for everyone.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Juliano Belletti: “Is Hafiz Gariba is ready to step up to the first team? My job is to prepare Hafiz. He’s a very dynamic player, so his workload needs to be carefully managed. Our style of play demands a lot from him. He’s in good form, and the challenge is to maintain that level. Is he ready? All my players are ready, and I make sure they’re at their peak for the first team.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Juliano Belletti on Mirza Catovic: “He has settled in quickly and already adapted to our system. He can play as a defensive midfielder and, at times, as a central midfielder. He's strong, talented and highly motivated to make the most of his opportunities. He arrived with great humility, eager to adapt to what we expect from him, and he's making very good progress. As a coach, I'm looking to get the best out of him.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Juliano Belletti, on whether coaching Barcelona’s first team is his biggest ambition: “My main goal is to make sure my players are well prepared. I believe in taking things one step at a time. I did the same as a player, and I think it helped me. If I focus too much on the destination, I might lose sight of the journey. I want to do things the other way around, focusing on the process so that I’m better prepared when the time comes.” #fcblive
🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Jorge Mendes is knocking on every door to find a WAY OUT for Balde. [@MatteMoretto] #fcblive
